entities.summary: Gabriel Janowski is a Polish politician and activist of opposition in Poland. His first term as a politician was as senator in the Senate, then as a deputy in the first, third and fourth terms of the Sejm. From 1991 to 1993 he was the Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development.
